title: 第5章 贪心不足蛇吞象第6章 都是举手之劳
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“崔神医，你说的‘回天十三针’是什么？他还真会医术不成？”
金宝路对于陈凡的医术表示质疑。
每一个在宝路医院住院的病人，都会登记详细的信息。
陈凡入狱前就是个刚刚大学毕业不久，在社会底层闯荡的普通人而已，入狱后，更是自毁前途。
金宝路甚至都已经认定陈凡这种人这辈子已经毁了，对于这种废人，如果不是发生了今天的事情，他是根本看都懒得看一眼的。
连给自己提鞋都不配！
却怎料，崔富接下来的话，却让金宝路大吃一惊！
“回天十三针，起死人，肉白骨！
只要不是命元耗尽，还有一口气在，都能救活！”
此话一出，金宝路不禁倒吸一口凉气。
他当然相信崔富的眼光是不会错的。
“这么厉害！
这小子从哪里学来的？”
金宝路再看向陈凡时，忽然冷静了下来。
如果只是一只毫无利用价值的蝼蚁，踩死当然没有问题。
但现在陈凡会‘回天十三针’，那就不一样了。
“你的‘回天十三针’从哪来学到的？你的师父是谁？”
崔富问道。
“我师父的名号可不是你们这些凡人能打听的，别痴心妄想了。”
陈凡不屑地扫视着对方说道。

陈凡当然不会告诉崔富，自己学的回天十三针，只是师父随便在这个世界找的一本医道典籍而已。
如今陈凡只是练气七层的修为，除了炼制丹药外，救人偶尔还需要用到银针，若是到了筑基，救人手法那就更不可思议了，崔富连看都看不懂！
“崔神医跟你说话，是你的荣幸！
你别不识抬举！”
金宝路寒声警告道。
“可笑！
这么说来，他也会回天十三针了？想要指点我一番？”
陈凡笑道。
崔富老脸憋得通红，如果他会回天十三针的话，那就不可能在这里了。
不过，这也更加坚定了他想要得到这门神针术的信念！
崔富扭头给了金宝路一个眼神，金宝路马上会意地点了点头。
content_en:
"Divine Doctor Cui, what are the 'Thirteen Needles of Returning Heaven' you are talking about? Is he really good at medical treatment?"
Jin Baolu expressed doubts about Chen Fan's medical skills.
Every patient hospitalized at Baolu Hospital will have detailed information registered.
Before he was imprisoned, Chen Fan was just an ordinary person who had just graduated from college and was struggling at the bottom of society. After being imprisoned, he even ruined his future.
Jin Baolu has even concluded that people like Chen Fan have been ruined in this life. For such a useless person, if it hadn't happened today, he would not even bother to look at it.
He’s not even worthy enough to carry his own shoes!
Unexpectedly, Cui Fu's next words surprised Jin Baolu!
“Thirteen needles of returning to heaven, resurrecting the dead, flesh and bones!
As long as the life force is not exhausted and there is still breath left, he can be saved! "
As soon as these words came out, Jin Baolu couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
Of course he believed that Cui Fu's vision was correct.
"So awesome!
Where did this kid learn this? "
When Jin Baolu looked at Chen Fan again, he suddenly calmed down.
If it were just a worthless ant, of course there would be no problem in crushing it to death.
But now that Chen Fan knows how to ‘return to heaven with the Thirteen Needles’, it’s different.
"Where did you learn the 'Thirteen Needles of Kaitian'? Who is your master?"
Cui Fu asked.
"My master's name is not something you mortals can inquire about, so don't have any wishful thinking."
Chen Fan glanced at the other party with disdain and said.
Of course, Chen Fan would not tell Cui Fu that the Thirteen Needles of Huitian that he learned was just a medical book that his master randomly found in this world.
Nowadays, Chen Fan is only at the seventh level of Qi training. In addition to refining elixirs, he occasionally needs to use silver needles to save people. When it comes to foundation building, the methods of saving people are even more incredible. Cui Fu can't even understand them!
“It’s your honor for Divine Doctor Cui to talk to you!
Don't you know how to praise! "
Jin Baolu warned in a cold voice.
"Ridiculous!
So, he will also be healed by Thirteen Needles? Want to give me some advice? "
Chen Fan smiled.
Old Cui Fu's face turned red from suppressing the pain. If he knew how to return to heaven with thirteen needles, he wouldn't be here.
However, this also strengthened his belief in obtaining this magical acupuncture technique!
Cui Fu turned his head and gave Jinbao Lu a look, and Jinbao Lu immediately nodded knowingly.
